      boolean setSelectedQuantity​(int amount)
      Selects a quantity by its button and waits for the panel to show it. 1, -1 for All, or a number the panel has a button for. Anything else is refused without a click, and the log nam es the buttons that are there. The panel adds buttons as you carry m ore silver bars. Seen on a live panel: SILVER BARS CARRIED BUTTONS SHOWN 5 1, X, All 6 1, 5, X, All 12 1, 5, 10, X, All SilverCrafting.setSelectedQuantity(7): the silver panel has buttons [1, 5, 10, X, All] and none for 7, and it is not driven through its X prompt - a typed quantity does not show on the panel, so it cannot be confirmed. Nothing was clicked. W hy not X. It was tried twice, with 5 and with 7: the prompt opened, the number was typed and taken, the game said nothing, and nothing on the panel changed. X still read "X" and All stayed lit. That is also what a person sees doing it by hand. A quantity that cannot be read back cannot be confirm ed, and m aking an unconfirm ed number of things is worse than refusing. XPE method.
